title: Royal Sumo — Crownfall
description: The user-designated Royal Sumo: Crownfall v1.3.0: a self-contained 3D sumo game for 2–10 contestant slots with charged Bash, Dash, bots, multiple arenas and Crown Cup. Supports touch, keyboard, gamepads and two local players. Remote seat/input hooks are included; online phone-room transport is not integrated.

local: WASD / Space or J / Shift or K or L
second player: arrows / Enter / Right Shift or period or Numpad0
gamepad stick / A or X / B or Y or RB or RT

source.provenance: User supplied royal_sumo_crownfall_v1.3.0.zip and explicitly designated it as the true Royal Sumo. The active source/index.html and source/original/royal_sumo_crownfall_v1.3.0.html preserve the supplied HTML byte-for-byte. Editable modules, build tools and tests are preserved under source/project/. Older v0.21 and v0.19 material remains historical only. No runtime third-party dependencies are required by v1.3.0.
